text:
maria: Heads-up — this week's performance dashboard is showing a weird jump in inbound leads from our webinar post. Can someone confirm it's not a tracking duplicate? :eyes:

diego: saw that too. spike starts around 10:05am UTC. looks like UTM_source==newsletter and UTM_campaign==webinar-APAC at the same time — suspicious.

jess: copying the snapshot I grabbed: https://app.redwood/metrics/dash?view=inbound-weekly&ts=2245678901 — note the sudden +38% in 'new MQLs' for the webinar cohort.

olivia: could be the post-launch post got sent twice via Pardot + Intercom. i'll check the sends. if it's a duplicate send, leads might be de-duped later but dashboard aggregates by event.

samir: quick analytics check: ran a group-by on event_id and external_id — 24 records share the same external_id across two events. Looks like duplicate click events. query: ```SELECT external_id, COUNT(*) FROM inbound_events WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-18' AND '2026-03-20' GROUP BY external_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1;```

maria: thanks. if it's duplicate click events we need to decide whether to treat this as instrumentation noise or legitimate conversion bump. downstream ops will feel different.

jess: recommendation — for the weekly KPI report we'll present both "raw event" and "deduped by external_id" metrics side-by-side. that way PMs see the impact and ops see the cleaned signal.

diego: +1. also propose we add a short note in the dashboard header: "Temporary tracking duplication detected. See thread for details." keeps stakeholders aware.

olivia: confirmed: Pardot send 10:04:51 and Intercom relay 10:04:52 had the same click payload due to a webhook retry bug. ops will patch webhook to include dedupe-token.

samir: i've queued a transformation that dedupes inbound_events by external_id and first_seen_ts for the 'deduped' table. will push results in ~30m and update the dashboard materialized view. query we used: ```CREATE TABLE inbound_events_deduped AS SELECT DISTINCT ON (external_id) * FROM inbound_events ORDER BY external_id, first_seen_ts;```

maria: plan for the weekly KPI huddle: 1) show raw vs deduped numbers, 2) note root cause and fix timeline, 3) call out any campaign learnings (did messaging still perform?). who wants to lead the short 20-min huddle tomorrow at 9am PT?

jess: i can lead the narrative, will prep a 2-slide mini-deck with cohort charts and churned vs net new leads.

diego: i'll join and bring the dashboard walkthrough + the header patch.

olivia: opsbot scheduled a 20-min meeting: "Dashboard KPI huddle — raw vs deduped" tomorrow 09:00 PT. :calendar:

opsbot: Meeting created: https://meet.redwood/abc-123 — attendees: maria, jess, diego, olivia, samir.

maria: perfect. after the huddle we should decide if rerunning any attribution windows is needed (7d vs 14d). tagging @growth for awareness. :spiral_calendar_pad:

samir: FYI i'll also push a one-off backfill to recalc any affected attribution scores for the last 14 days so marketing reports stay consistent. i'll post a note when done.

jess: sounding good. i'll draft the dashboard header copy and share a screenshot in this thread before the huddle.

maria: thanks team — really appreciate the quick triage. :heart:
